highlights: 1D Decoding: EAN13, EAN 8, UPC-A, UPC-E0, UPC-E1, Code128, Code39, Code93, Interleaved 2 of 5, Industrial 25, Matrix 2 of 5, Code11, CodeBar, MSI, RSS-14, RSS-Ltd, RSS-Exp, Standard 2 of 5, Plessey, ChinaPost 25, GS1 Composite
2D Decoding: QR Code, Data Matrix (DM), PDF417, Han Xin, Micro PDF417, Micro QRCode, MaxiCode, Aztec Code, Code16K
System Interfaces: RS-232 serial port; USB keyboard; USB virtual serial port
【Versatile Scanning】YESIDO EC21 is a universal handheld barcode scanner capable of reading various 1D and 2D barcodes with high-speed decoding and sensitive response.
